presentation_title: The Anatomy of a Good Prompt: The 3 C's
episode: 2.1: The Anatomy of a Good Prompt (The 3 C's)
learning_objectives: Define the three key ingredients of an effective AI prompt: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Apply the principles of Clarity, Context, and Constraints to construct better AI prompts.
Recognize the impact of a well-structured prompt on AI output quality.
outline: Introduction: The Impact of Good Prompts
The 3 C's: Clarity, Context, and Constraints
prerequisites: Basic understanding of how to interact with AI chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT, Bard).

slides.title: Welcome to The Anatomy of a Good Prompt
slides.narration:
Hello everyone!
Welcome to this tutorial.
Today, we will learn how to write effective prompts.
This is key for good AI interaction.
We will focus on the '3 C's'.
slides.image_prompt: Title slide with 'The Anatomy of a Good Prompt' as the main heading. Below, 'The 3 C's' is a subheading. A friendly, cartoonish AI robot is thinking.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
At the end of this tutorial, you will be able to:
Define Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
You will apply these principles to your prompts.
You will also recognize their impact on AI output.
slides.image_prompt: A slide with three bullet points listing the learning objectives. A magnifying glass icon next to 'Define', a toolbox icon next to 'Apply', and a lightbulb icon next to 'Recognize'.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
To follow along, you need basic understanding.
You should know how to use AI chatbots.
Examples include ChatGPT or Bard.
slides.image_prompt: A person sitting at a laptop, interacting with a generic AI chatbot interface. Simple icons representing knowledge or prior experience.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
You will need a computer.
Ensure it has internet access.
Any AI chatbot will work.
For example, ChatGPT.
slides.image_prompt: Simple cartoon illustration of a desktop computer with a Wi-Fi symbol. A hand points to a generic AI chatbot logo.

slides.title: The Power of a Good Prompt
slides.narration:
Have you ever got a strange answer from an AI?
That's because of a weak prompt.
A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A strong prompt gets a smart answer.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a confused person looking at a laptop screen showing a nonsensical AI response. Next to it, a happy person looking at a screen showing a helpful AI response. Arrows connecting 'weak prompt' to 'confused person' and 'strong prompt' to 'happy person'.

slides.title: The 3 C's of Prompting
slides.narration:
The best prompts have three key ingredients.
They are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Let's explore each one.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic showing three interconnected pillars. Each pillar is labeled: 'Clarity', 'Context', 'Constraints'. A central AI brain icon is at the top, benefiting from these pillars.

slides.title: 1. Clarity: Be Specific!
slides.narration:
Let's start with Clarity.
The AI cannot read your mind.
Vague prompts give generic answers.
Specific prompts yield helpful results.
slides.image_prompt: Section header graphic: 'Clarity'. A cartoon illustration of a person thinking with a question mark, then pointing clearly to a specific object, and an AI robot 'understanding' with a lightbulb.

slides.title: Clarity: A Simple Analogy
slides.narration:
Think of it like ordering food.
If you just say 'food', what do you get?
But if you say 'a vegetarian pizza with extra cheese',
you get exactly what you want.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a customer at a restaurant counter. First, the customer vaguely says 'food' and the chef looks confused. Then, the customer clearly says 'vegetarian pizza', and the chef smiles, holding a pizza.

slides.title: Clarity: Before Example
slides.narration:
Consider this prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
Is it clear?
What is the AI supposed to focus on?
slides.image_prompt: On ChatGPT interface. Close-up: user typing 'Write about electric cars'. The AI response area is blank, waiting.

slides.title: Clarity: Reflect and Improve
content: What should the AI focus on?
slides.narration:
Think about it.
What should the AI focus on?
Who is the target audience?
What is the desired output?
This prompt is too vague.
slides.image_prompt: Pause animation: a thought bubble with question marks above a person's head, looking puzzled at a screen. Text overlay: 'Pause and think.'

slides.title: Clarity: Action - Improve the Prompt
content: Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration:
Now, let's improve it.
Type this better version:
'Write a blog post: 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers.'
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: user typing the improved prompt into a chatbot interface. The text 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city' appears on screen.

slides.title: Clarity: After - See the Difference!
slides.narration:
See the difference?
The AI now knows the topic, length, and audience.
This prompt is much more focused.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: a generic, unhelpful AI response to 'Write about electric cars'. Right: a more specific, helpful response to the improved prompt. A green checkmark appears on the right.

slides.title: 2. Context: Give it Background!
slides.narration:
Next, let's add Context.
Context tells the AI 'why' you are asking.
It helps AI adopt the right perspective.
It sets the correct tone.
slides.image_prompt: Section header graphic: 'Context'. A cartoon illustration of an AI robot being given a file or document labeled 'Background Info', showing it helps the AI understand better.

slides.title: Context: Analogy
slides.narration:
Imagine telling a story.
Background details matter, right?
Similarly, AI needs the full picture.
Give it context.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a person telling a story to a listener. The listener initially looks confused, then smiles and nods as more background details are shared.

slides.title: Context: Before Example
content: Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration:
Let's revisit our good prompt.
'Write a blog post: 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers.'
What kind of blog is this for?
slides.image_prompt: On ChatGPT. Close-up: the previous good prompt is displayed. A thought bubble above it asks, 'Who is the audience? What kind of blog?'

slides.title: Context: Reflect and Improve
content: How should the AI frame its response?
slides.narration:
Pause and think.
What is the blog's focus?
What is the audience's interest?
How should the AI frame its response?
We need more background.
slides.image_prompt: Pause animation: a person pondering, a clock ticking. Text overlay: 'Pause and think.'

slides.title: Context: Action - Add Background
content: Better Prompt: 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration:
Let's add context.
Type this improved version:
'Write a blog post for a sustainable living blog: 3 EV benefits for city dwellers.'
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: user typing the contextualized prompt into a chatbot interface. The text 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city' appears on screen.

slides.title: Context: After - More Relevant Output
slides.narration:
Now AI knows the blog's theme.
The output will be more relevant.
It understands the angle to take.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: AI output without blog context. Right: AI output with 'sustainable living blog' context, showing a more tailored response. A green checkmark on the right.

slides.title: 3. Constraints: Set the Rules!
content: Tell AI length, style, and tone.
slides.narration:
Finally, let's look at Constraints.
Constraints are boundaries.
They shape the output format.
Tell AI the length, style, and tone you need.
slides.image_prompt: Section header graphic: 'Constraints'. A cartoon illustration of an AI robot building something within clear boundaries or a fenced area, showing limits being applied.

slides.title: Constraints: Analogy
slides.narration:
Think of following a recipe.
Specific steps and amounts ensure the desired outcome.
Constraints work the same way for AI.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a chef following a recipe book with precise measurements and steps. The final dish looks perfect. Without the recipe, the chef looks confused.

slides.title: Constraints: Before Example
content: Better Prompt: 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
slides.narration:
Our current prompt is good.
'Write a blog post for a sustainable living blog: 3 EV benefits for city dwellers.'
What is missing?
slides.image_prompt: On ChatGPT. Close-up: the previous better prompt is displayed. A thought bubble above it asks, 'What about length? Tone? Format?'

slides.title: Constraints: Reflect and Improve
content: Should it end with a question?
slides.narration:
Think about it.
What is the word count?
What tone should it have?
Should it end with a question?
These are important constraints.
slides.image_prompt: Pause animation: a person thinking, looking at a checklist with boxes for 'word count', 'tone', 'format'. Text overlay: 'Pause and think.'

slides.title: Constraints: Action - Set the Rules
content: Excellent Prompt: 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments.'
slides.narration:
Let's add constraints.
Type this excellent prompt:
'Blog post: 3 EV benefits for cities. Friendly, under 400 words. Ask a question.'
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: user typing the fully constrained prompt into a chatbot interface. The complete text appears on screen.

slides.title: Constraints: After - Perfect Output
content: AI delivers exactly what you need.
slides.narration:
This prompt is excellent!
AI will deliver exactly what you need.
The output will match all your requirements.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: AI output without specific constraints. Right: AI output perfectly matching word count, tone, and ending question. A gold star appears on the right.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
slides.narration:
Here is a bonus tip: Provide a Persona.
Tell the AI who to be.
It adopts that role.
The output becomes more specialized and insightful.
slides.image_prompt: Section header graphic: 'Bonus Tip: Persona'. A cartoon illustration of an AI robot wearing different hats (e.g., chef hat, doctor's coat, explorer's hat), representing different roles it can adopt.

slides.title: Persona: Example
content: Prompt: 'Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food.'
slides.narration:
For example:
'Act as budget travel agent. Create 5-day Rome itinerary for solo history/food lover.'
The AI will respond as a travel agent.
slides.image_prompt: On ChatGPT. Close-up: user typing the persona-based prompt. A thought bubble above the AI shows it transforming into a cartoon travel agent with a map and suitcase.

slides.title: Summary of Good Prompting
slides.narration:
Let's summarize.
For good prompts, remember the 3 C's:
Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
For even better results, add a Persona.
slides.image_prompt: A summary slide showing three large icons for Clarity (magnifying glass), Context (scroll/document), and Constraints (ruler/boundary). A smaller icon for Persona (a mask) is next to them. All are linked to a central 'Good Prompt' icon.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Pick a simple topic of your choice.
Create three versions of the prompt.
Note which technique made the biggest difference.
slides.narration:
Now, as an assignment:
Pick a simple topic of your choice.
Apply Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Create three versions of the prompt.
Compare the AI outputs.
Note which technique made the biggest difference.
